posts.title: Is anybody really using Claude Fable 5?
posts.summary: Fable 5. Anthropic’s “Mythos-class” Artificial Intelligence model which they have bubble-wrapped just enough to permit us less civilized chimps to touch. “Mythos-class”, I say, but not actually “Mythos” because that model is too dangerous for the average.

posts.title: An Introduction to Rohaan's Ramblings
posts.summary: After years of avoiding online writing, I’m starting this space because I miss the simple act of putting my own thoughts into words. This will be a Non Generative AI Zone: both my writing and my thoughts will be unfiltered.
